mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% annualized over the previous 3 months signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPI annualized growth > 2% does not correlate with negative returns (Pearson correlation p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points over the previous 3 months signals weakening labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or UNRATE increase > 0.5pp does not correlate with negative returns (Pearson correlation p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in real GDP (GDPC1) by more than 1% quarter-over-quarter signals a contraction in economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or GDPC1 QoQ decline > 1% does not correlate with negative returns (Pearson correlation p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary policy, which is expected to lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 40% of instances despite the positive signal, or FEDFUNDS decrease does not correlate with positive returns (Pearson correlation p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 over the previous month signals a strengthening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or PAYEMS increase > 200,000 does not correlate with positive returns (Pearson correlation p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and a decrease in retail and food services sales (RSAFS) signals a shift in consumer spending from services to durable goods, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the interaction of HOUST increase and RSAFS decrease does not correlate with positive returns (Pearson correlation p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals increased economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or INDPRO increase > 1% MoM does not correlate with positive returns (Pearson correlation p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A combination of a rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and a decreasing consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) signals a tightening monetary policy with controlled inflation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the interaction of FEDFUNDS increase and CPIAUCSL decrease does not correlate with positive returns (Pearson correlation p > 0.05).
